rationale: C07 is the direct institutional and substantive foundation for the later letter. It establishes the same President's Commission on Veterans' Pensions, assigns the same comprehensive review of pension, compensation, and related nonmedical benefits, identifies the same military/social/economic/fiscal considerations and relationship to broader social-security benefits, requires federal-agency cooperation, and sets the identical November 1, 1955 final-report deadline. The child converts that operative framework into an expanded commissioning letter to the chairman. C04 and C08 are weaker but structurally similar chairman letters concerning presidential study commissions or boards, their assignments, cooperation, and reporting deadlines.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Commission on Veterans' Pensions, of which you are the Chairman, has been appointed by me to carry out a comprehensive study of the laws and policies pertaining to pension, compensation, and related nonmedical benefits for our veterans and their dependents.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established a Commission which shall be known as the President's Commission on Veterans' Pensions... The Commission is authorized and directed to make a comprehensive survey and appraisal of the structure, scope, and administration of the laws of the United States providing pension, compensation, and related nonmedical benefits to veterans and their dependents.
shared_material.explanation: The child restates C07's creation, identity, and core assignment of the same commission using closely corresponding language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: rapid and profound changes in our national military, social, economic, and fiscal circumstances have occurred which affect fundamentally our long-standing veterans' pension and compensation programs.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission shall give particular attention to: (a) Changes in basic military, social, fiscal, and economic factors in our society affecting the role of these benefits.
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive four-factor analytical framework is carried into the child and expanded factually.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the relationships between these benefits and others which are provided our citizens without regard to their status as veterans.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The relationship of various veterans' benefits... to the broader social security and other benefits which are provided to persons without regard to their status as veterans.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close substantive and verbal reuse of C07's required comparison between veterans' benefits and general social programs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In this task you will have the full cooperation of the administration, including the facilities of the executive agencies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance... as it may require.
shared_material.explanation: The child recasts C07's formal agency-cooperation provision as an assurance to the chairman.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I ask that your final report with its recommendations be in my hands by November 1, 1955.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission shall make a final written report, including findings and recommendations, to the President... not later than November 1, 1955.
shared_material.explanation: The reporting product, recipient, and exact deadline are identical.
